Name: Yandere Haley Dialogue Expansion
Author: Kxgarashii
Description:
[i][size=1][i][size=1][center]Hey! I'm back again. Welcome to my second mod! To those of you who are returning from my Alex mod, thanks for the encouragement and patience. :)
To anyone who is new, welcome! This mod pretty much just makes Haley batshit crazy in love, so beware. Unless that’s exactly what you came for, then in which case I hope you enjoy ;)
Please let me know about any typos, repetitiveness, errors, etc in the mod. I’ll fix them ASAP. [/center][/size][/i][/size][/i]
[b][size=5]Warnings![/size] [/b]
[i][size=1]*There are behaviors depicted in this mod that may be uncomfortable or triggering. Download at your own risk. This mod is purely fictional and I do not condone this behavior irl[/size][/i]
Swearing 
Violence
Obsessive/psychotic behavior
Suggestive Themes

[size=5]Instructions[/size]
1. Make sure you have Content Patcher and SMAPI installed. Unique Courtship is optional
2. Unzip the file
3. Open your "Stardew Valley\Mods" folder and drop the folder called "[CP] Yandere Haley Dialogue Expansion" there
That's it!
[size=1][i]*To see solely the yandere dialogue using "Unique Courtship", go to the config.json in Unique Courtship's mod file and change "enableHaley" from "enabled" to "disabled"
*You must first reach 2 hearts with Haley before any yandere dialogue will appear[/i][/size]

[size=5]Requirements[/size]
SMAPI
Content Patcher
Unique Courtship (optional, it allows unique bouquet and pendant dialogue) 

[size=5]Use[/size]
[i][size=2]*Uploading videos, screenshots, etc is perfectly fine
*You are allowed to edit this mod for your own use
*Do not upload this mod on other sites[/size][/i][center]﻿[/center][center][i][size=1]*Haley will refer to the player as either male or fem[/size][/i][i][size=1]ale. If there’s anyone who would like me to change the dialogue to be gender-neutral, I’ll happily do so!
[/size][/i][size=1]﻿[i]*Okay so I may or may not be obsessed with yanderes?? They’re a lot of fun to create to be honest.[/i][i] Elliott will be next :)[/i][/size][/center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7713][center]Yandere Alex[/center][/url]
